_meta.semantics: SSE opened first: decision_done (and any pipeline frames) already emitted, then ONE ruke_error with the same 503 message text, then [DONE]. The HTTP STATUS stays 200 — the 503 number does NOT survive on this path; only the message text is the cross-path contract.
_meta.normalization: Stage-event "ms" timing values replaced with "<ms>" in logicalFrames; progress-path bodies are ms-normalized text. P1 (2026-11-01): the live <runtime_clock> system block carries wall-clock text, so its content is MASKED in bodyText (the clock text itself is pinned by clock unit tests).

{"model":"strata-mock","stream":true,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"RESPONSE POLICY FOR THIS ASSISTANT:
- Answer the request that was actually made, at the depth it asks for: a short question gets a short, direct answer; an explicit request for detail, comparison or steps gets the detail.
- Ordinary small talk and status questions stay brief and natural. Do not convert them into a report, a plan, or a list.
- Do not advertise capabilities, tools, integrations or services unless the human asks what you can do or what is available.
- Never describe work that is not actually happening: no claimed searches, files, background jobs, indexing or progress that did not run.
- If something is not possible here, say so plainly in one line instead of replacing it with a broader offer."},{"role":"system","content":"<runtime_clock>MASKED</runtime_clock>"},{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}
